decision.headline: Credits are not the enterprise platform price.
decision.body: The enterprise agreement pays SARVAX for the operating layer, named access, approved capability suites and workflow governance. Model inference, OCR, transcription, meeting-bot usage, storage, premium data and paid third-party services are separate variable costs paid economically by the client.
decision.primaryRoute: Where technically feasible, the client contracts with or pays the underlying provider directly through client-owned accounts.
decision.fallbackRoute: A capped SARVAX-managed pass-through budget may be offered only when direct payment is impractical. It is an alternative, not the default and not represented as an automated wallet feature.
decision.salesRule: Never quote credits as if they include the platform, and never sell every catalog agent as a separate bot SKU.

workflow.title: Workflow 2.0: one outcome, many agents
workflow.definition: Workflow 2.0 is a directed execution map: it defines which agent or deterministic step runs, what it depends on, which connector it may use, where branches run in parallel, where results merge, when a human must approve and what counts as completed work.

steps.detail: The system pauses. An authorized reviewer approves, rejects or requests correction.

controls: Dependency ordering prevents downstream work from running before required inputs exist.
Parallel branches reduce cycle time when work is independent.
Fan-in waits for branches and merges their outputs before the next step.
MCP or standard connectors are bound to specific steps and permitted actions.
Human approval pauses consequential actions before writeback or outbound execution.
Retries and timeouts handle bounded operational failures.
Run history records step status, approvals, outputs, failures and completion.

variableUsage.internalOnly: SARVAX may track tokens or internal credits for telemetry, budgeting and cost reconciliation. Customer proposals should lead with meetings, documents, KYC cases, reports and completed workflows.

readiness.rule: Do not sell 12 separate bot SKUs. Sell business capability suites (e.g., Compliance Suite or Relationship Intelligence Suite) tied to firm outcomes.
Platform pricing covers software and governance. Model tokens, OCR, transcription, and paid data feeds are client-funded via direct keys or accounts.
Brochure agents require explicit Product and QA sign-off before committing to live deployment timelines or turnkey performance.

readiness.claim: 4. Custom Work Requires a Separate SOW
readiness.rule: Custom custodian integrations, legacy migrations, and bespoke agents must be scoped under a separate Statement of Work (SOW).
